description: Create a provisional Clickwise affiliate and tracked links, as request_tracked_links does, and return them as renderable cards, an HTML embed snippet and a JSON feed for a publisher's site or app. Email is optional; the account is claimed later for payout.

claim_email.description: Optional email to claim the account (and payout) later.

program_ids.description: Optional specific program IDs; omit to let Clickwise pick fitting merchants.

publisher_url.description: The app/site/profile where the feed will be embedded.

topic.description: Audience/content topic, e.g. travel deals, AI shopping assistant, sneakers.

name: get_monetization_feed
title: Get monetization feed
